description: This file defines the ServerRequestFactory class in the Slim Framework, responsible for creating PSR-7 ServerRequest objects from various sources, including global PHP variables and method calls. It implements the ServerRequestFactoryInterface and provides methods for generating server requests with proper headers, cookies, URI, and body streams.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating PSR-7 ServerRequest objects from various sources, including direct method calls and global PHP environment, implementing the ServerRequestFactoryInterface.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new PSR-7 ServerRequest object with the specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Static method that creates a ServerRequest object representing the current global PHP server environment, parsing headers, cookies, input stream, and uploaded files.
